description:
## Why
stoa-4291i requires a working Dockerfile before any other OCI work.

## What
Write a multi-stage Dockerfile:
- Builder stage: rust:1.80-slim, cargo build --release --locked, strip binary
- Runtime stage: gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12, ENTRYPOINT ["/stoa-mail"], UID 65532
- Tag scheme: git SHA + semver tag
- Verify: docker build from clean checkout produces image under 100 MB
- Verify: runs as non-root

## Acceptance
- docker build succeeds from clean checkout
- docker inspect shows non-root USER
- docker images shows size < 100 MB
title: Dockerfile: multi-stage distroless OCI image for stoa-mail
